grandparents_cupboard.reason: All butter shortcrust, cheddar, cream, eggs, mustard and fresh vegetables are ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including the ready-rolled all-butter shortcrust and mature cheddar, is a standard Tesco line at an everyday price.

basic_kitchen.reason: A loose-bottomed tart tin, frying pan, grater and whisk are common kit, and lining a tin with ready-rolled pastry suits a confident beginner.

works.reason: Four eggs and 300ml of liquid with 400g of softened turnip and leek suits a 23cm tin for four, and the preheated tray at 180°C fan for 35 to 40 minutes should set the custard and crisp the unblind-baked base.

honest_times.reason: Peeling and dicing 400g of turnips, slicing the leeks, lining the tin and whisking fits in about 30 minutes, and 15 minutes of cooking, 40 of baking and 10 of resting add up to roughly 80.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient is used in the steps under its true name, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm turnip and leek quiche suits a cold early February lunch, and the turnips are clearly the main point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: Clear, friendly British English with practical cues such as the slight wobble in the middle and trimming the overhang after baking.

hearty_healthy.reason: A vegetable-packed egg and cheese quiche is a proper, filling lunch that a family would happily make again.
